notes.title: This is a special Christmas.
notes.content:
We apologize for not releasing the holiday version of our game on time. 
However, we have some good news to share.
[list]
[*] TKA's development team has grown, which will help us manage the workload better. New experienced members will allow us to focus more on designing interesting gameplay and content, improving the game's quality and development speed.
[*] A few weeks ago, I started modifying the code to implement NPC teammates. I then thought, why not go further and implement multiplayer co-op? This idea excites me because it allows for more fun gameplay. However, I realized that almost all game logic needs to be rewritten, which is a huge task. TKA was developed as a single-player game without considering network synchronization. After weighing the pros and cons, I decided it's worth doing. I plan to implement this feature gradually to avoid affecting the update cycle too much.
[*] The custom challenge map (MOD feature) was already completed but needs modification due to the reasons mentioned above. If we delay this, all custom map MODs will become invalid. So, I plan to enable the feature after adjusting the game mechanics code.
[*] The script for Chapter 2 is almost complete, and new scenes, zombies, characters, and actions are in production.
[/list]

Once again, thank you all for your understanding and support. 
Merry Christmas!

notes.title: Version 0.5.0.1 has been released!
notes.content:

- Reworked human enemy alertness, they will abandon pursuit after a few seconds if they fail to detect the target.
- Updated the save checkpoint safety detection mechanism, you can save if there are no zombies within 3 meters of you.
- Revised the backpack system, stamina consumption is slightly increased when running, but does not affect item storage. Additionally, increased the initial capacity. (Temporarily lowered this mechanic to implement character attribute enhancements in the future)

- On the Easy difficulty, lowered the rotation speed of the fan that requires rolling.
- Removed the leap attack from the Predator and reduced its health.
- Expanded the combat area with the Predator.
- A new hairstyle has been added to Jodi's office mirror.

Bug Fixes:

- Issues with dragging bodies causing rolls and jumps.
- Default dodge and roll direction restored to backward.
- In difficult mode, full health will also be displayed as critically injured after loading a save.
- Issue with save files not generating zombies in cheat mode.
- Zombies without heads cannot be eliminated.
- The final Predator in the A5 rooftop fight will not move in the New Game+.
- The door to the A1 floor passageway will not open after going through the mechanisms in the New Game+.
- The Black Suit is not displayed in the wardrobe.
- Occasionally consumes stamina while aiming.
- No footsteps on stairs.
- Explosions from gas canisters lack killing power.

If you have the Saved Game in the E0 Staff Quarters, you can load it and re-experience the later part of the changes.

Again, I apologize for the poor experience of the previous version, this version has been optimized a lot and hopefully will redeem your goodwill towards The Killing Antidote.

notes.title: The Killing Antidote will be released soon
notes.content:
Dear players,

I regret to inform you that the release of The Killing Antidote, originally scheduled for October 2, 2024, has been delayed due to the Steam backend review process being in a waiting state. This unforeseen delay unfortunately prevents us from meeting the initial release date.

We are working tirelessly to resolve the issue and expect an update within a few days. Once the review is
completed, the game will be immediately released.

This delay is entirely my responsibility as I failed to allocate sufficient time for the review process. Given
that this is our first game, we lack sufficient experience with the Steam platform. We understand your
disappointment and sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

The upcoming version of The Killing Antidote features:

[list]
[*] A variety of gameplay experiences, blending close combat, shooting, decryption, tower defense, roguelite,
[*] fashion change, and collection.
[*] A full story mode chapter (estimated playtime 5 hours) and 6 challenge modes.
[*] 230+ outfits and accessories to freely mix and match.
[*] 30 different hairstyles.
[*] Customizable makeup options.
[*] 8 types of weapons, with 3 attack styles for melee weapons: normal attack, throw, and critical strike. Critical
[*] strikes are most effective when zombies are in knockdown state.
[*] Maximum damage is dealt by attacking the head of zombies. Attacking limbs will interrupt limb functionality.
[*] 7 different types of zombies, each with unique characteristics and behaviors.
[*] 1 human enemy type.
[*] Various interactive items and interesting decryption puzzles.
[*] The Dream Castle is a completely randomized scenario, resulting in a unique experience every playthrough.
[*] Challenge modes allow progression to unlock and upgrade 20 different attributes, enhancing combat effectiveness.
[/list]

notes.title: June Development Progress Report
notes.content:
I have noticed that time seems to be slipping by rather quickly. It feels like just yesterday I was starting out, and now a month has already passed! But I know some of you might feel that time is dragging on during the wait for the game's release.

Naux has been working on several cutscenes recently, which are quite challenging. He has been persisting despite the difficulties. The use of motion capture equipment has improved our production efficiency. I regret that we did not purchase it sooner. Despite discovering significant accuracy and stability issues with the equipment, which fall far short of the official specifications, we have had to manually correct numerous animations. If possible, I would like to invest in better equipment in the future.

Despite being in Early Access (version 0.5), the current chapter of the story mode should be completed as it offers a complete gameplay experience.

New features added:

- Data recovery: Damaged hard drives can be repaired in the office, recovering some of the data. This is a mini-game.
- Briefcase: A password-protected briefcase containing rewards. Cracking the password requires using a password detector, which is also a mini-game.
- Clothing color adjustment: Option to change the color of clothing.
- Jodi's office upgrade: Jodi's office has been improved.
- Secret cabinet: A new cabinet that Jodi can hide in, especially useful when sneaking around.
- Elevator

I constantly generate new ideas and jot them down in my notebook. I then pick the most suitable ones to develop. The longer-term ones are saved for future versions. In short, The Killing Antidote is not just a cosmetic zombie-shooting game. I hope the game will have rich content and gameplay mechanics.

The next release is expected to take another month or so.

Thanks for your support, understanding, and patience. We will strive to deliver better works in the future.

notes.title: The Killing Antidote 0.4.7 has been released
notes.content:
Dear friends, we are very happy to inform you that a new playtest version of our game has been released.

[h2]What's new[/h2]
- Plot mode advances to Bathroom Quest
- New challenge mode: Nightmare Castle
- Added two new witch costumes
- Added over-the-shoulder camera left and right shoulder toggle (melee attack aiming issues to be resolved)

[h2] Improvements[/h2]
- Add new item: Marker
- After passing the level, everything in the backpack is automatically put into the item box

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
- A lot 😁

[h2]About "Nightmare Castle"[/h2]
This is a brand new challenge mode we designed especially for Halloween. This underground castle is completely randomized and is a different maze every time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43431795/76bc82fc3da80642b1bc935558736f682f915f8a.png[/img]

There are also deadly traps and mechanisms, and all kinds of zombies roaming around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43431795/edc348c4b87247bb9a2ed5b4d2b16499407f93dc.png[/img]

We need to find and smash 9 pumpkins before the exit opens. The heroine will win when she reaches the exit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43431795/a959e9035e7dfad564860748b64f0c2b55351737.png[/img]

But it's not easy to get out safely, because this place is run by the Grim Reaper, who kills anyone who trespasses without mercy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43431795/ec82892e26cc4945e8b2e8ad7daf6668dd87d2a3.png[/img]

- Hardcore mode generates a larger maze
- Shooting the crossbow mechanism pauses its firing for a few seconds.
- Attacking Reaper slows his movement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43431795/d8386883ae22017a1c36f5fc3c90bab7877537d1.png[/img]

[h2]About the Marker Tool[/h2]
This item can be placed anywhere in the scene, and then we can press the activation key (V by default) at any time to see where the marker tool is located, making it easy to recognize the direction to go back. In the maze, it is easy to mark the location of the exit room.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43431795/6c9f8c6f8317b3a79bc1a30ebbdd9a9aa8f81dbf.png[/img]

[h2]Words from the development team[/h2]
We have many more interesting ideas that will be gradually crafted into the game later. We look forward to seeing everyone's feedback.
Wish you all have fun.

The design prototype is the Witch in left 4 dead, which is also a tribute to the classic. But there are still differences, there are very different.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43431795/4bf00f877f0794680fed7c28318fa22ea1d31acd.png[/img]

More action will be added later.

Every day we came to the office, the security guard was surprised and asked, "Are you still working today?" Yes, we work every day, for the ideal, for everyone's expectation, our work must be the best.

The game is still under development, and a new test version is expected to be released in a few weeks, so stay tuned.
